dataset/cities.parquet.note: One row per city: sampling design, inclusion probabilities and design weights, GHS-FUA identity, country, continent, climate, HDI tertile, centroid, area.

dataset/cities.csv.note: Same table as cities.parquet, as plain CSV.

dataset/city_year/spherical_2017.parquet.note: Spherical summary of the embedding within each city and support: N, mean resultant length Rbar, mean direction mu_A00..mu_A63, per-axis mean and standard deviation, tangent variance. 13 supports per city.

dataset/city_year/spherical_2018.parquet.note: Spherical summary of the embedding within each city and support: N, mean resultant length Rbar, mean direction mu_A00..mu_A63, per-axis mean and standard deviation, tangent variance. 13 supports per city.

dataset/city_year/covariates_2017_2024.p.note: Aggregate covariates (mean, p10, p50, p90, sd; class fractions) within each city and support and year. 11 supports per city.

dataset/reference/global_land_2024_conte.note: Global land reference, context: 247,565 equal-area-sampled land pixels for 2024 with coordinates, WorldCover, GHS-SMOD, climate and population. Join on pixel_id.

dataset/reference/global_land_2024_embed.note: Global land reference, embeddings: unit-norm AlphaEarth vectors A00..A63 (float32) for the same 247,565 pixels, in the same row order. Join on pixel_id.

dataset/sentinel1b/paired_global_sample_.note: Global paired sample used for the Sentinel-1B outage test.

dataset/sentinel1b/city_support_points_7.note: Sentinel-1 support points per city (730-city cohort, 8 per city).

dataset/placebo/spherical_native_pseudo_.note: Placebo city summaries, native and pseudo placements, 2024.

dataset/placebo/covariates_native_pseudo.note: Placebo city summaries, native and pseudo placements, 2024.

placebo_samples_native_2024.parquet.note: Placebo city pixel samples, native placement, 2024. Concatenated from 4 rank-chunk exports.

placebo_samples_pseudo_2024.parquet.note: Placebo city pixel samples, pseudo placement, 2024. Concatenated from 5 rank-chunk exports.

pixels_2017.parquet.note: Pixel samples: up to 250 per city per degree-of-urbanisation support. A00..A63 are the unit-norm AlphaEarth embedding (float32); the remaining columns are pixel covariates with valid_* flags.
